llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The Host interface in the OpenTelemetry Collector needs a new GetExtension(id ID) (Component, bool) method for direct extension lookup by ID. This change requires updating the interface definition in component/host.go and all Host implementations across multiple repositories. The modification is backward compatible and improves performance by eliminating the need to iterate through the entire extensions map.

FILES:
- opentelemetry-collector/component/host.go — Defines the core Host interface that must be updated with the new GetExtension method
- opentelemetry-collector/component/componenttest/nop_host.go — Test implementation of Host interface that must implement the new method
- opentelemetry-collector-contrib/ — Contrib extensions repository that uses Host for extension lookup and must update implementations
- jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/extension.go — Jaeger uses Host interface for extension lookup and must be updated
- tempo/modules/distributor/forwarder/forwarder.go — Tempo uses Host interface for extension lookup and must be updated
